_provenance.notes: OpenBao KV v2 invariants. The read/API path carries the data/ infix (secret/data/<slug>/<sub>) for consul-template / `bao read` / the HTTP API, and the v2 response nests the payload under .Data.data.<field> (double data). The `bao kv` CLI takes the BARE logical path (secret/<slug>/<sub>) and injects data/ itself — passing the data/ form to `bao kv` doubles it (secret/data/data/...), which was the fix-consumer-db-bridge-kv-v2-path defect. policy-<slug> grants secret/data/<slug>/*.
